bio: Daughter of James McGuire and Anna C. Jones; enumerated as Theresa Maguire in her father's Larksville household in 1910. She married Samuel A. Powell in 1934 and died at Nanticoke on 31 Mar 1998, aged 94 ([R4-S1]).
